requirements.quote: Mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.

requirements.quote: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).

requirements.quote: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.

requirements.quote: Each door handle or step shall be illuminated by not more than one lamp.

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not be switched ON unless the vehicle is stationary and one or more of the following conditions is satisfied:, except that the exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall be switched OFF when the vehicle is no longer stationary.

requirements.quote: However, if any of the lamps of the rear end collision alert signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.

requirements.quote: The rear-end collision alert signal shall not be switched ON if the direction indicator lamps, the hazard warning signal or the emergency stop signal is activated.

However, if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on one of the axles, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached;

requirements.quote: However, if the maximum permissible laden mass is obtained before the permissible load on the axle, the loading of the boot(s) shall be limited to the figure which enables that mass to be reached.

requirements.text: The angle of the light beam from the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following loading conditions;.
requirements.quote: The angle of the light beam from the dipped-beam headlamps shall be determined under the following loading conditions;

requirements.text: If a visual inspection of the dipped-beam pattern on the screen or a photometric method is used, measurement shall be carried out in a dark environment (for example, a dark room) of sufficient area to allow the vehicle and the screen to be placed as shown in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: If a visual inspection of the dipped-beam pattern on the screen or a photometric method is used, measurement shall be carried out in a dark environment (for example, a dark room) of sufficient area to allow the vehicle and the screen to be placed as shown in Figure 1.

requirements.text: Headlamp centres of reference shall be at a distance from the screen of at least 10 m.
requirements.quote: Headlamp centres of reference shall be at a distance from the screen of at least 10 m.

requirements.text: The ground on which measurements are made shall be as flat and horizontal as possible, so that the reproducibility of measurements of dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀ 0.5 mrad (±0.05 per cent inclination).
requirements.quote: The ground on which measurements are made shall be as flat and horizontal as possible, so that the reproducibility of measurements of dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀ 0.5 mrad (±0.05 per cent inclination).

requirements.text: If a screen is used, its marking, position and orientation in relation to the ground and to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, shall be such that the reproducibility of the measurement of the dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀0.5 mrad (∀0.05 per cent inclination).
requirements.quote: If a screen is used, its marking, position and orientation in relation to the ground and to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, shall be such that the reproducibility of the measurement of the dipped-beam inclination can be assured with an accuracy of ∀0.5 mrad (∀0.05 per cent inclination).

requirements.text: During measurements, the ambient temperature shall be between 10 and 30 °C.
requirements.quote: During measurements, the ambient temperature shall be between 10 and 30 °C.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be carried out on a vehicle which has travelled a distance of between 1,000 km and 10,000 km, preferably 5,000 km.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be carried out on a vehicle which has travelled a distance of between 1,000 km and 10,000 km, preferably 5,000 km.

requirements.text: Tyres shall be inflated to the full-load pressure specified by the vehicle manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Tyres shall be inflated to the full-load pressure specified by the vehicle manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be fully replenished (fuel, water, oil) and equipped with all the accessories and tools specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be fully replenished (fuel, water, oil) and equipped with all the accessories and tools specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Full fuel replenishment means that the fuel tank shall be filled to not less than 90 per cent of its capacity.
requirements.quote: Full fuel replenishment means that the fuel tank shall be filled to not less than 90 per cent of its capacity.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have the parking brake released and the gearbox in neutral.
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall have the parking brake released and the gearbox in neutral.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be conditioned for at least 8 h at the temperature specified in paragraph 3.4. above.
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be conditioned for at least 8 h at the temperature specified in paragraph 3.4. above.

requirements.quote: The variations in either dipped-beam or vehicle inclination, depending on the method chosen, shall be measured separately for each side of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The results obtained from both left and right headlamps under all the load conditions specified in Annex 5, shall be within the limits set out in paragraph 5.5. below.
requirements.quote: The results obtained from both left and right headlamps under all the load conditions specified in Annex 5, shall be within the limits set out in paragraph 5.5. below.

requirements.text: The load shall be applied gradually without subjecting the vehicle to excessive shocks.
requirements.quote: The load shall be applied gradually without subjecting the vehicle to excessive shocks.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be prepared as specified in paragraph 4. above and laden as specified in Annex 5 (first loading condition of the respective vehicle category).

requirements.text: Before each measurement, the vehicle shall be rocked as specified in paragraph 5.4. below.
requirements.quote: Before each measurement, the vehicle shall be rocked as specified in paragraph 5.4. below.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made three times.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made three times.

requirements.text: If none of the three measured results differ by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination) from the arithmetic mean of the results, that mean shall constitute the final result.
requirements.quote: If none of the three measured results differ by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination) from the arithmetic mean of the results, that mean shall constitute the final result.

requirements.text: If any measurement differs from the arithmetic mean of the results by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination), a further series of 10 measurements shall be made, the arithmetic mean of which shall constitute the final result.
requirements.quote: If any measurement differs from the arithmetic mean of the results by more than 2 mrad (0.2 per cent inclination), a further series of 10 measurements shall be made, the arithmetic mean of which shall constitute the final result.

requirements.text: The vehicle suspension and any other part likely to affect dipped-beam inclination shall be activated according to the methods described below, except that the technical authorities and manufacturers may jointly propose other methods (either experimental or based upon calculations), especially when the test poses particular problems, provided such calculations are clearly valid.
requirements.quote: The vehicle suspension and any other part likely to affect dipped-beam inclination shall be activated according to the methods described below. However, the technical authorities and manufacturers may jointly propose other methods (either experimental or based upon calculations), especially when the test poses particular problems, provided such calculations are clearly valid.

requirements.text: category vehicles with conventional suspension With the vehicle standing on the measuring site and, if necessary, with the wheels resting on floating platforms (which shall be used if their absence would lead to restriction of the suspension movement likely to affect the results of measurements), rock the vehicle continuously for at least three complete cycles, for each cycle, first the rear and then the front end of the vehicle is pushed down.
requirements.quote: category vehicles with conventional suspension With the vehicle standing on the measuring site and, if necessary, with the wheels resting on floating platforms (which shall be used if their absence would lead to restriction of the suspension movement likely to affect the results of measurements), rock the vehicle continuously for at least three complete cycles, for each cycle, first the rear and then the front end of the vehicle is pushed down.

requirements.text: The rocking sequence shall end with the completion of a cycle.
requirements.quote: The rocking sequence shall end with the completion of a cycle.

requirements.text: Before making the measurements, the vehicle shall be allowed to come to rest spontaneously.
requirements.quote: Before making the measurements, the vehicle shall be allowed to come to rest spontaneously.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is fitted with a manual headlamp-levelling system, the latter shall be adjusted to the positions specified by the manufacturer for given loading conditions (according to Annex 5).

requirements.text: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner; in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner; in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

requirements.text: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.text: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

requirements.text: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

requirements.text: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
requirements.quote: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.

requirements.text: If the type of separate technical unit submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraphs 6.16., 6.17. and 6.18. below, approval of that type of separate technical unit shall be granted.
requirements.quote: If the type of separate technical unit submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraphs 6.16., 6.17. and 6.18. below, approval of that type of separate technical unit shall be granted.

requirements.text: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every separate technical unit conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark consisting of:.
requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every separate technical unit conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark consisting of:

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the separate technical unit data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the separate technical unit data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of conformity of production before type approval is granted.
requirements.quote: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of conformity of production before type approval is granted.

requirements.text: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are either:.
requirements.quote: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are either:

requirements.text: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.

requirements.text: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.
requirements.quote: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.

requirements.text: These provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
requirements.quote: These provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.

requirements.text: To apply the 10 daN force a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used.
requirements.quote: To apply the 10 daN force a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used.

requirements.text: Where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.
requirements.quote: Where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.

requirements.text: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
requirements.quote: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.

requirements.text: These projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
requirements.quote: These projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.

requirements.text: Projecting visors and rims shall be permitted on headlights, provided that their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout.
requirements.quote: Projecting visors and rims shall be permitted on headlights, provided that their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout.

requirements.text: In the case of a headlamp mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.
requirements.quote: In the case of a headlamp mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.

requirements.text: The projections shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The projections shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Retracting headlights shall meet the provisions of paragraph 6.2.1. above in both the operative and retracted positions.
requirements.quote: Retracting headlights shall meet the provisions of paragraph 6.2.1. above in both the operative and retracted positions.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more, except that if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more. However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The windscreen wiper fittings shall be such that the wiper shaft (number 1 in Figure 0) is furnished with a protective casing (number 1.1 in Figure 0) which has a radius of curvature meeting the requirements of paragraph 5.4. above and an end surface area of not less than 150 mm².
requirements.quote: The windscreen wiper fittings shall be such that the wiper shaft (number 1 in Figure 0) is furnished with a protective casing (number 1.1 in Figure 0) which has a radius of curvature meeting the requirements of paragraph 5.4. above and an end surface area of not less than 150 mm².

requirements.text: In the case of rounded covers, these shall have a minimum projected area of 150 mm² when measured not more than 6.5 mm from the point projecting furthest.
requirements.quote: In the case of rounded covers, these shall have a minimum projected area of 150 mm² when measured not more than 6.5 mm from the point projecting furthest.

requirements.text: These requirements shall also be met by rear window wipers and headlamp wipers.
requirements.quote: These requirements shall also be met by rear window wipers and headlamp wipers.

requirements.text: Paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to the wiper blades (number 4 in Figure 0), supporting members (number 3 in Figure 0) if present, to second holder (number 2.2 in Figure 0) if present, to the functional hinge between the holder head and the holder (number 5 in Figure 0) if present, or to the junction between the main and the second holder (number 6 in Figure 0) if present, except that these units shall be so made as to have no sharp angles or pointed or cutting parts.
requirements.quote: Paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to the wiper blades (number 4 in Figure 0), supporting members (number 3 in Figure 0) if present, to second holder (number 2.2 in Figure 0) if present, to the functional hinge between the holder head and the holder (number 5 in Figure 0) if present, or to the junction between the main and the second holder (number 6 in Figure 0) if present. However, these units shall be so made as to have no sharp angles or pointed or cutting parts.

requirements.text: Compliance with the provisions in paragraphs 6.4.1 and 6.4.2 shall be verified with the wipers in parked position.
requirements.quote: Compliance with the provisions in paragraphs 6.4.1 and 6.4.2 shall be verified with the wipers in parked position.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The projection shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.
requirements.quote: The projection shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: If lateral door handles rotate to operate, they shall meet one or other of the following requirements:.
requirements.quote: If lateral door handles rotate to operate, they shall meet one or other of the following requirements:

requirements.text: In the case of handles which rotate parallel to the plane of the door, the open end of handles must be directed towards the rear.
requirements.quote: In the case of handles which rotate parallel to the plane of the door, the open end of handles must be directed towards the rear.

requirements.text: The end of such handles shall be turned back towards the plane of the door and fitted into a protective surround or be recessed.
requirements.quote: The end of such handles shall be turned back towards the plane of the door and fitted into a protective surround or be recessed.

requirements.text: Handles which pivot outwards in any direction which is not parallel to the plane of the door shall, when in the closed position, be enclosed in a protective surround or be recessed.
requirements.quote: Handles which pivot outwards in any direction which is not parallel to the plane of the door shall, when in the closed position, be enclosed in a protective surround or be recessed.

requirements.text: The open end shall face either rearwards or downwards.
requirements.quote: The open end shall face either rearwards or downwards.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply.

requirements.text: The wheels, wheel nuts, hub caps and wheel discs shall not exhibit any pointed or sharp projections that extend beyond the external plane of the wheel rim.
requirements.quote: The wheels, wheel nuts, hub caps and wheel discs shall not exhibit any pointed or sharp projections that extend beyond the external plane of the wheel rim.

requirements.text: Wing nuts shall not be allowed.
requirements.quote: Wing nuts shall not be allowed.

requirements.text: When the vehicle is travelling in a straight line, no part of the wheels other than the tyres, situated above the horizontal plane passing through their axis of rotation shall project beyond the vertical projection, in a horizontal plane of the external surface or structure, except that if functional requirements so warrant, wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure on condition that the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part is not less than 30 mm and that the projection beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure in no case exceeds 30 mm.
requirements.quote: When the vehicle is travelling in a straight line, no part of the wheels other than the tyres, situated above the horizontal plane passing through their axis of rotation shall project beyond the vertical projection, in a horizontal plane of the external surface or structure. However, if functional requirements so warrant, wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure on condition that the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part is not less than 30 mm and that the projection beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure in no case exceeds 30 mm.

requirements.text: Sheet-metal edges, such as gutter edges and the rails of sliding doors, shall not be permitted unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation which are applicable to it.
requirements.quote: Sheet-metal edges, such as gutter edges and the rails of sliding doors, shall not be permitted unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation which are applicable to it.

requirements.text: An unprotected edge shall be considered to be folded back either if it is folded back by approximately 180º, or if it is folded towards the bodywork in such a manner that it cannot be contacted by a sphere having a diameter of 100 mm.
requirements.quote: An unprotected edge shall be considered to be folded back either if it is folded back by approximately 180º, or if it is folded towards the bodywork in such a manner that it cannot be contacted by a sphere having a diameter of 100 mm.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to the following sheet metal edges: rear edge of bonnet and front edge of rear luggage boot.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to the following sheet metal edges: rear edge of bonnet and front edge of rear luggage boot.

requirements.text: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.
requirements.quote: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.

requirements.text: As an exception to this requirement an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: As an exception to this requirement an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use.
requirements.quote: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use.

requirements.text: Opening roofs shall be considered only in the closed position.
requirements.quote: Opening roofs shall be considered only in the closed position.

requirements.text: Convertible vehicles shall be examined with the hood in both the raised and lowered positions.
requirements.quote: Convertible vehicles shall be examined with the hood in both the raised and lowered positions.

requirements.text: With the hood lowered, no examination shall be made of the vehicle inside an imaginary surface formed by the hood when in the raised position.
requirements.quote: With the hood lowered, no examination shall be made of the vehicle inside an imaginary surface formed by the hood when in the raised position.

requirements.text: Where a cover for the linkage of the hood when folded is provided as standard equipment, the examination shall be made with the cover in position.
requirements.quote: Where a cover for the linkage of the hood when folded is provided as standard equipment, the examination shall be made with the cover in position.

requirements.text: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
requirements.quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.

requirements.text: Luggage racks and ski racks shall be so attached to the vehicle that positive locking exists in at least one direction and that horizontal, longitudinal and transverse forces can be transmitted which are at least equal to the vertical load-bearing capacity of the rack as specified by its manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Luggage racks and ski racks shall be so attached to the vehicle that positive locking exists in at least one direction and that horizontal, longitudinal and transverse forces can be transmitted which are at least equal to the vertical load-bearing capacity of the rack as specified by its manufacturer.

requirements.text: For the test of the luggage rack or ski rack fixed to the vehicle according to the manufacturer's instructions, the test loads shall not be applied at one point only.
requirements.quote: For the test of the luggage rack or ski rack fixed to the vehicle according to the manufacturer's instructions, the test loads shall not be applied at one point only.

requirements.text: Surfaces which, after installation of the rack, can be contacted by a sphere of 165 mm diameter shall not have parts with a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, unless the provisions of paragraph 6.3. can be applied.
requirements.quote: Surfaces which, after installation of the rack, can be contacted by a sphere of 165 mm diameter shall not have parts with a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, unless the provisions of paragraph 6.3. can be applied.

requirements.text: Fastening elements such as bolts that are tightened or loosened without tools shall not project more than 40 mm beyond the surfaces referred to in paragraph 6.16.2. above, the projection being determined according to the method prescribed in paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation, but using a sphere of 165 mm diameter in those cases where the method prescribed in paragraph 2.2. of this annex is employed.
requirements.quote: Fastening elements such as bolts that are tightened or loosened without tools shall not project more than 40 mm beyond the surfaces referred to in paragraph 6.16.2. above, the projection being determined according to the method prescribed in paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation, but using a sphere of 165 mm diameter in those cases where the method prescribed in paragraph 2.2. of this annex is employed.

requirements.text: Radio receiving and transmitting aerials shall be fitted to the vehicle in such a way that if their unattached end is less than 2 m from the road surface in any position of use specified by the manufacturer of the aerial, it shall be inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes which are 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Radio receiving and transmitting aerials shall be fitted to the vehicle in such a way that if their unattached end is less than 2 m from the road surface in any position of use specified by the manufacturer of the aerial, it shall be inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes which are 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Furthermore, aerials shall be so fitted to the vehicle, and if necessary their unattached ends so restricted, that no part of the aerials protrude beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Furthermore, aerials shall be so fitted to the vehicle, and if necessary their unattached ends so restricted, that no part of the aerials protrude beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Shafts of aerials may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm, except that the unattached ends shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: Shafts of aerials may have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm. However, the unattached ends shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The bases of aerials shall not project more than 40 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The bases of aerials shall not project more than 40 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Paragraphs 6.17.4. and 6.17.4.1. above shall not apply to aerials located behind the vertical transversal plane passing through the "R" point of the driver, provided that the maximum projection of the aerial including its housing does not exceed 70 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Paragraphs 6.17.4. and 6.17.4.1. above shall not apply to aerials located behind the vertical transversal plane passing through the "R" point of the driver, provided that the maximum projection of the aerial including its housing does not exceed 70 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If the aerial is located behind that vertical plane but projects more than 70 mm, paragraph 6.17.4.1. above shall apply using a projection limit of 70 mm instead of 40 mm.
requirements.quote: If the aerial is located behind that vertical plane but projects more than 70 mm, paragraph 6.17.4.1. above shall apply using a projection limit of 70 mm instead of 40 mm.

requirements.text: The assembly instructions shall contain sufficient information to enable the approved components to be mounted on the vehicle in a manner that complies with the relevant provisions of paragraphs 5. and 6. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The assembly instructions shall contain sufficient information to enable the approved components to be mounted on the vehicle in a manner that complies with the relevant provisions of paragraphs 5. and 6. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In particular, the positions of use must be indicated for telescopic aerials.
requirements.quote: In particular, the positions of use must be indicated for telescopic aerials.
